title: Rabbi Chiyya bar Nachmani
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rabbi Yishmael’s student. He speaks in Rabbi Yishmael’s name in [Berakhot 48b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.48b.10) and in [Mekhilta, Pischa 16:22](https://www.sefaria.org/Mekhilta_DeRabbi_Yishmael%2C_Tractate_Pischa.16.22) (Hyman cites Bo 16:3).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli calls Rabbi Chiyya bar Nachmani Rabbi Yishmael’s student and quotes him speaking in Rabbi Yishmael’s name. The linked Mekhilta gives the same transmission with a different modern paragraph number.
